info.name: Odyssey API — Complete runner
info.description: Run all requests in order against a test Atlas database. Requires an existing promoted admin account. Creates fresh users and one restaurant; cancels bookings and soft-deletes the restaurant at the end. Covers auth, restaurants, capacity, reservations, admin filters, FIFO waitlist, history, and logout.

exec: pm.test('Paged restaurant list', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.limit).to.equal(2); });

item.name: Reject five people at one table
User B cannot book full slot
Reject restaurant deletion while in use
User B cannot view A booking
User B cannot edit A booking
Admin filters, sorts, and pages bookings

exec: pm.test('Filtered paged result', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.page).to.equal(1); pm.expect(b.limit).to.equal(1); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('reservationAId')); });

pm.test('B offered', () => { const e = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('waitlistBId')); pm.expect(e.status).to.equal('offered'); pm.expect(e.offerExpiresAt).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('C waiting', () => { const e = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('waitlistCId')); pm.expect(e.status).to.equal('waiting'); });

item.name: User C cannot accept before offer
User C receives offer after capacity increase

exec: pm.test('C offered', () => { const e = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('waitlistCId')); pm.expect(e.status).to.equal('offered'); });

item.name: Admin cannot reduce capacity below two bookings
User B joins second slot waitlist

exec: pm.test('Paged cancelled list', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.equal(2); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(3); pm.expect(b.items.every(x => x.status === 'cancelled')).to.equal(true); });
